# Date Time Range Picker

Choose start and end dates with independent wall-clock times.

## Usage

### Maintenance

Choose a multi-day maintenance window with independent start and end times.

<ComponentExample component="date-time-range-picker" scenario="maintenance" title="Maintenance" description="Choose a multi-day maintenance window with independent start and end times." :index="0" />

### Office hours

Choose a start and end time constrained to ordinary office hours.

<ComponentExample component="date-time-range-picker" scenario="office-hours" title="Office hours" description="Choose a start and end time constrained to ordinary office hours." :index="1" />

### Controlled

Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component.

## Floating positioning

This component uses the shared positioning engine. Use the [live positioning example](/guide/positioning) to change `side`, `align`, offsets, collision boundaries, strategy, and tracking while inspecting the resolved placement.

## Style available and selected dates

Style availability and selection from the public ARIA state on calendar cells. You do not need a second visual-only list that can drift from the component policies.

```css
[data-scope='date-time-range-picker'][data-part='cell'][aria-selected='true'] {
  background: CanvasText;
  color: Canvas;
}

[data-scope='date-time-range-picker'][data-part='cell'][aria-disabled='true'] {
  opacity: .45;
  text-decoration: line-through;
}
```

For SSR or tests that need a stable initial month, set the API `referenceDate` so the first rendered view does not depend on the current clock.

## Accessibility

Two labeled date-time fields and the calendar grid keep the start and end endpoints distinct.
